company.name: Circle
company.shortDescription: Circle helps businesses and developers utilize stablecoins for payments and online commerce.
company.description:
Circle is a financial technology company that develops and manages digital currencies and blockchain-based financial infrastructure. It issues USD Coin (USDC) and Euro Coin (EURC), both fully backed stablecoins designed for global payments and digital transactions. 

Circle's platform supports businesses in integrating stablecoins into their operations, including cross-border payments and financial applications.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Post IPO Equity round raised $222,000,000, or 8.33% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 18 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,500,000,000 to $7,650,000,000, a 1.7x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
